QuestInfo.name: A Father's Love
QuestInfo.0: Jonas gave me a new doll he made to give to his daughter.  I don't think Sophilia'll like it as much her favorite one, but I guess I should give it to her anyway, per her father's wishes.
QuestInfo.1: I gave Sophilia the new doll her father made.  It made her sad.  She asked me give Annabelia, the first doll Jonas made for her, back to her father.
QuestInfo.2: Jonas was very confused by the doll I gave him. He was almost speechless. I hope he is not going any more insane than he is right now.

0.0: Thank you for finding my doll! Annabelia say 'Hello'!\r\n\r\n#L0##bHere's a gift from your father.#l#k
0.1: What's that? You went and saw Daddy? And he said he had a gift for me?\r\n\r\n#L0##bYes. Here it is.#l#k
0.2: Another new doll? <Frowns> This doesn't look much like me at all, I should think. Poor Daddy. Sometimes I wish he would spend less time making toys and more time with me. Could... could you do something else for me?

yes.1: Can you give Annabelia to him? I don't like to be parted from her again, but I think my Dad needs her more than I do.

no.0: Please... it would mean a lot to both me and Daddy if you do this. And he really needs my help now. I hope you change your mind.

1.0: Why, what's this old ragged thing? \r\n\r\n#L0##bSophilia told me to give this to you. It's her favorite doll.#l#k
1.1: My daughter asked you to give me this? But why? It's dirty and old... I've made hundreds of different dolls better and more advanced than this one! But wait... I remember this one... this... this is the first doll I made for her, when I was but a fledgling Toy Maker. She kept it? All this time?

npc.0: You haven't given my doll to my Dad yet? Please find Daddy and give my doll to him. Annabelia will help him.

lost.0: Hey, you're back! <Frowns> I found Annabelia lying on the ground. I hope you didn't leave her on purpose. Please, take her to Daddy. It's very important that he has her.

yes.0: Just don't forget it this time. I am counting on you!
